name: Baños de Valdearados (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of white, green and blue in the proportions 2:1:1, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Baños de Valdearados (a tree above waves, inscribed BAÑOS).
history: Municipal flag of Baños de Valdearados; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Baños de Valdearados arms — tree above waves, inscribed BAÑOS
